title: welcome (runtime -> connector)
description: Accepts a hello. Fixes the negotiated version, session id, heartbeat, limits, the result of a resume request and the rooms this connector is bound to.

pcp.description: Negotiated version: same MAJOR, MINOR = min(connector, runtime).

heartbeat_ms.description: Each side sends a ping if it has sent nothing for this long; two missed pongs = dead connection.

resume.description: Present when the hello asked to resume.

last_seq.description: Highest seq the runtime has processed. The connector replays everything after it, in order, before new frames.

reason.description: Why a resume was refused (unknown/expired session).

replay_window_events.description: Events the connector should keep for resume.

ack_every_events.description: Runtime acks at least this often (events).

bindings.description: Rooms this connector should be in for the bot instances bound to it (admin console). The connector joins missing ones; room passwords are never sent here (a room.join action carries them).

bot.description: Bot instance id bound to this room.

audio.description: This room is the one the audio pipeline listens to / speaks into.

subscribe.description: Optional event filter: the connector may skip emitting event types not listed (saves bandwidth for audio.segment, presence). Absent = everything.
